entries.title: Ezekiel 23:1
segments: The word of the LORD came again to me,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:2
segments: Son of man, there were two women, the daughters of one mother.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:3
segments: And they fornicated in Egypt; they whored in their youth, their breasts were handled, and there their virgin nipples were worked.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:4
segments: And their names [were] Oholah, the oldest, and Oholibah, her sister. And they were Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria [is] Oholah, and Jerusalem [is] Oholibah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:5
segments: And Oholah whored under Me. And she lusted after her lovers, to [her] Assyrian neighbors,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:6
segments: clothed with purple, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:7
segments: So she bestowed her harlotries on them, the choice sons of Assyria; [with] all of them, and with all whom she lusted after; she defiled herself with all their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:8
segments: Nor did she leave her fornications from Egypt. For in her youth they lay with her, and they worked her virgin nipples, and poured their fornications on her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:9
segments: Therefore I have given her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians on whom she lusted.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:10
segments: They uncovered her nakedness. They took her sons and her daughters and killed her with the sword. And she became notorious among women, and they executed judgment on her.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:11
segments: And her sister Oholibah saw, she was more corrupt in her lust than she, and her fornications were greater than her sister's whoredom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:12
segments: She lusted to the sons of Assyria, governors and rulers nearby, clothed most perfectly; horsemen riding horses, all of them desirable young men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:13
segments: And I saw that she was defiled, one way [was] to both of them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:14
segments: And she added to her fornications. And she saw men carved on the wall; images of the Chaldeans engraved with vermilion,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:15
segments: girded with girdles on their loins, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the sons of Babylon [in] Chaldea, the land of their birth;

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:16
segments: and she lusted after them, to the look of her eyes, and sent messengers to them into Chaldea.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:17
segments: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with fornications. And she was defiled with them, and her mind was alienated from them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:18
segments: So she uncovered her fornications and uncovered her nakedness. And My soul was alienated from her just as My soul was alienated from her sister.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:19
segments: Yet she multiplied her fornications to recall the days of her youth, in which she had played the harlot in the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:20
segments: And she lusted on her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose issue [is like] the issue of horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:21
segments: So you longed for the wickedness of your youth, when the Egyptians worked your nipples, for the sake of the breasts of your youth.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:22
segments: So, O Aholibah, the Lord Jehovah says this: Behold, I will raise up against you your lovers, from whom your soul is alienated; and I will bring them against you from all around;

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:23
segments: the Babylonians, and all the Chaldeans, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, [and] all the Assyrians with them; all of them desirable young men, governors and rulers, all of them, third heads and called ones; all of them riding on horses.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:24
segments: And they shall come against you [with] weapons, chariots, and wheels, and with an assembly of peoples; buckler and shield and helmet shall set against you all around. And I will set judgment before them, and they shall judge you by their judgments.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:25
segments: And I will set My jealousy against you, and they shall deal with you in fury. They shall take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you shall fall by the sword. They shall take away your sons and your daughters, and the rest of you shall be devoured by the fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:26
segments: They shall also strip you [of] your clothes and take away your beautiful jewels.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:27
segments: So I will make your wickedness to cease from you, and your fornication from the land of Egypt. And you shall not lift up your eyes to them, nor shall you remember Egypt any more.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:28
segments: For so says the Lord Jehovah: Behold, I will give you into the hand of [those] whom you hate, into the hand of whom your soul was alienated, from them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:29
segments: And they shall deal with you in hatred, and shall take away all your labor, and shall leave you naked and bare. And the nakedness of your fornications shall be uncovered, both your wickedness and your fornications.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:30
segments: These [things] will be done to you because you have whored after the nations, and because you are defiled with their idols.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:31
segments: You have walked in the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:32
segments: So says the Lord Jehovah: You shall drink of your sister's cup deep and large; you shall be laughed to scorn and mocked; for it holds much.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:33
segments: [In] drunkenness and sorrow you are filled, the cup of horror and ruin, the cup of your sister Samaria.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:34
segments: You shall even drink it and empty it. And you shall break its pieces, and tear off your own breasts. For I have spoken, says the Lord Jehovah.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:35
segments: So the Lord Jehovah says this: Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your back, therefore bear also your wickedness and your adulteries.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:36
segments: And the LORD said to me: Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah, and declare to them their abominations,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:37
segments: that they have committed adultery, and blood [is] on their hands? And they have committed adultery with their idols and have also caused their sons whom they bore to Me to pass through the fire to them, to devour them.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:38
segments: And yet they have done this to Me: They have defiled My sanctuary in that day, and have profaned My sabbaths.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:39
segments: And when they had slain their sons to their idols, then they came into My sanctuary in that day to profane it. And lo, this they have done in the midst of My house.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:40
segments: And they have even sent for men to come from far, to whom a messenger [was] sent. And lo, they came. You washed yourself for them, painted your eyes, and adorned yourself with ornaments,

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:41
segments: and sat on a stately bed with a table prepared before it, on which you set My incense and My oil.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:42
segments: And the sound of a crowd [was] at ease with her; and drunkards from the wilderness were brought with the men of the host of mankind; and they put bracelets on their hands, and crowns of beauty on their heads.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:43
segments: And I said about the one worn [in] adulteries, Will they now whore with her, and she [with them]?

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:44
segments: And they went in to her, as [they] go in to a woman of harlotry; so they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, the wicked women.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:45
segments: And [as] righteous men, they shall judge them [with] the judgment of adulteresses, and the judgment of women who shed blood; because they [are] adulteresses, and blood [is] in their hands.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:46
segments: For so says the Lord Jehovah: I will bring up a company on them, and will give them to be removed and stripped.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:47
segments: And the company shall stone them [with] stones, and cut them down with their swords. They shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses with fire.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:48
segments: So I will cause wickedness to cease out of the land, that all women may be taught, even not to go after your wickedness.

entries.title: Ezekiel 23:49
segments: And they shall put your wickedness on you, and you shall bear the sins of your idols. And you shall know that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.
